reports.category: Sextortion Scams: Learn and Report on Chainabuse
reports.description:
I met a Chinese girl on tinder. After that we switched to Whatsapp. After weeks of talking she persuaded me to invest in cryptocurrency on https://www.cbdcoinbtc.com/ - it seemed to me like a legit exchange. I registered and created an account. In total she gave me 113,000 USD in Bitcoin to invest in another cryptocurrency called MOD. 
My account showed me the value of the bitcoin she sent me - it seemed that this person did not lie to me at all, believed. So now it was my turn to invest my own money. I carried out transactions from my Coinbase account (www.coinbase.de). Over the course of some weeks I transferred BTC / ETH worth of approx. 16,000 USD at that time. After some weeks  with my investment and her BTC that she sent me I had collected enough money for my cause.The next step was to withdraw the money. This was the moment I realized I have been scammed. The transactions are from the day I triggered them (28th April 2021) until today, the moment I write this, still under review. I emailed the support of this exchange. They told me my transactions are under scrutiny because they seem risky, they will need 7 working days to manually audit them. In another email they wrote me that the transactions are frozen until the audit is done - they need another 2 months. After this email the wanted me to persuade to send more money to show that my account is not risky. Day after day I realized this is all a scam. On blockchain.com and etherscan.io I can check all my transactions and see that all the money has flown into different addresses since then._x000D_
So long story short: The money is gone. I beg you from the deepest spot of my heart to investigate in that matter and take different forms of legal action against the creator of this side. Further I hope that this is site is reported to Chinese authorities. Other victims may lose more. I somehow hope I can get my money back after you tracked them down.
